cases: old installed helper shows Update needed; cancel preserves exact old helper and unavailable status
authenticated update replaces old helper with protocol-compatible root-owned helper; actual Ready status
update_guidance: Administrator helper needs an update. Open Services and choose Update / reinstall helper.
session_properties:
Seat=seat0
Remote=no
Service=lightdm-autologin
Type=x11
Class=user
Active=yes
State=active
helper_policy:
org.ottrin.filesystem.privileged:
  description:       Run privileged operations for Ottrin
  message:           Authentication is required to perform this privileged operation in Ottrin.
  vendor:            Ottrin
  vendor_url:        https://github.com/hoozter/ottrin
  icon:              system-file-manager
  implicit any:      no
  implicit inactive: no
  implicit active:   auth_admin_keep
  annotation:        org.freedesktop.policykit.exec.path -> /usr/libexec/ottrin/ottrin-priv-helper
  annotation:        org.freedesktop.policykit.exec.allow_gui -> true

protected_helper.undo_and_cleanup: Success through fresh authenticated helper processes

gui_privileged_copy: Actual cp command denied, authenticated app retry created exact root-owned output; Activity authenticated Undo and confirmed/authenticated cleanup completed
